name: obix-compiler-ir
description: The canonical DOP IR of OBIX: the strongly typed, frontend-neutral, plain-data representation every syntax frontend lowers into — component, props, state, derived values, actions, effects, element, text, expression, attribute, property binding, event, conditional, iteration, component invocation, projection, style and accessibility metadata — with source provenance kept in a separate document, and the checks, deterministic serialization and equality that go with it. No Vue node, no React node, no JSX node, no runtime object. Phase 4 of the VueTS compiler recovery (docs/recovery/vuets-compiler.md).
author: Nnamdi Michael Okpala <okpalan@protonmail.com>
